purposes.en: I agree that my SACCO and AgroShield may record my name, phone number, national ID, ward and farm details to provide and administer my crop insurance, and share them with the insurer for that purpose only. My national ID and phone number are stored encrypted.
purposes.sw: Ninakubali SACCO yangu na AgroShield kuhifadhi jina langu, nambari ya simu, nambari ya kitambulisho, wadi na maelezo ya shamba ili kutoa na kusimamia bima ya mazao yangu, na kuyashiriki na kampuni ya bima kwa madhumuni hayo pekee. Kitambulisho na simu yangu vimehifadhiwa kwa usimbaji.

purposes.en: I agree to receive SMS about my cover, rainfall in my ward and payouts.
purposes.sw: Ninakubali kupokea SMS kuhusu bima yangu, mvua katika wadi yangu na malipo.

purposes.en: I agree that any payout from this cover is first paid to my outstanding SACCO loan, and any balance is paid to me.
purposes.sw: Ninakubali kwamba malipo yoyote ya bima hii yalipe kwanza mkopo wangu wa SACCO, na salio lolote nilipwe mimi.
